newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close up as foreign bidding returns.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close up as foreign bidding returns.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed up for the third straight session as foreign bidders returned to the market and local players took refuge from falling interest rates in shares, traders said.
The Merinvest composite index gained over one percent to end at 95.92 points.
Yields on benchmark six month TEMs fell over two percentage points Wednesday to 16.1 percent. Lower interest rates boost corporate earnings prospects.
"There's also been a return of foreign investors," said Provincial broker Diogenes Saenz, who saw most of the moderate trade focused on blue chips, which registered broad gains.
"There has been any real news to explain the upswing in trading," said one trader. "Maybe it's just a knock-on effect from an improving Wall Street."
